definitions.explanation: Something (usually negative like an accident, disaster, or problem) happening or breaking out.
The production or creation of something (heat, electricity, gas, etc.).

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}が{発生|はっせい}した。
{火災|かさい}の{発生|はっせい}を{防|ふせ}ぐ。
examples.english: To prevent the outbreak of fire.

examples.japanese: {熱|ねつ}が{発生|はっせい}する。

notes:
COMPOUND: {発|はつ} (emit, occur) + {生|せい} (life, birth)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事故|じこ}が{発生|はっせい}する (an accident occurs)
- {問題|もんだい}が{発生|はっせい}する (a problem arises)
- {火災|かさい}/{地震|じしん}が{発生|はっせい}する (fire/earthquake occurs)
- {電力|でんりょく}を{発生|はっせい}させる (generate electricity)
- {発生|はっせい}{源|げん} (source of occurrence)
- {発生|はっせい}{率|りつ} (rate of occurrence)

OFTEN USED FOR:
- Accidents, disasters, problems (negative events)
- Scientific contexts (generation of heat, electricity, etc.)
